observation_summary: The addOrUpdate method in XYSeries fails to correctly handle duplicate X values when they are allowed, leading to an IndexOutOfBoundsException or incorrect overwriting of existing data.
reasoning_summary: The bug is caused by an incorrect implementation of the logic for adding items to the series. The method does not account for the 'allowDuplicateXValues' flag when determining whether to update an existing item or add a new one. The fix requires modifying the logic (the algorithm) that decides how to insert the new item into the data list, which is a classic Algorithm/Method defect.
evidence_used: The bug report states: 'The method addOrUpdate(Number x, Number y) was never modified to support this [allowing duplicate X values], and therefore duplicate data were overwriting existing data.'
